metadata.description: A SchemaCel that snapshots a BUFFER STRUCT: a plain object whose values may be typed arrays (Float32/Float64/Int8/Uint8/Uint8Clamped/Int16/Uint16/Int32/Uint32 Array) alongside JSON-native scalars/arrays (dims, counters, RNG state). The default dehydrate is JSON-only, so bind this on a cel via metadata.schema:'buffers' to persist sim/mesh/gpu buffers. dehydrate encodes each typed array as {__ta, b64}; hydrate reconstructs the live typed array. isChanged is ref-eq (the host mutates in place + signals via a separate generation cel). The snapshot half of the CPU-resident-SoA interior.
